Comments.Comment: A demo of the Envelope Offset (Exx) command

The sound has a volume envelope (short fade-in), pitch envelope (very short) and a filter (long duration). The phrase then uses the Exx command to start playback from different position within these envelopes.
Note that the Exx command always treats any envelope as a "full range". So, no matter the duration, the middle position is always indicated by E80
